Wikipedia full-text search for 'transgender prisoners Palau' (MediaWiki API) returned only generic hits (Timeline of LGBTQ history, LGBTQ rights by country or territory, Sodomy law) with no Palau-specific trans-prisoner placement/segregation content. Penal Reform International's Global Prison Observatory Palau profile URL returned HTTP 404, and the GPO country/index/category pathways all return 404 (site structure no longer serves these URLs), so no PRI data existed to extract. The HRW World Report 2024 Palau chapter URL returned HTTP 404 (no such country chapter). The cached ILGA World Palau database page is a JavaScript stub with no extractable content. No documented cases/rulings on trans-prisoner housing in Palau found within budget.
